title: OSCAR: Offline Spectral Covariance-Aware Rotation for 2-bit KV Cache Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2605.17757v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: INT2 KV-cache quantization is attractive for long-context LLM serving, yet making it both accurate and practical remains challenging. Data-oblivious rotations such as Hadamard transforms flatten channel outliers, but still degrade sharply at INT2 because they ignore how downstream attention queries the cache. We propose OSCAR, an ultra-low-bit KV-cache quantization method that estimates attention-aware covariance targets offline and uses them to derive fixed per-layer rotations and clipping thresholds. By aligning the quantization basis with the second-moment structures consumed by attention, OSCAR preserves attention fidelity at 2-bit precision. Beyond theoretical analysis under a frozen-error surrogate, we build a serving-ready OSCAR system with fused Triton write and decode kernels that preserve paged KV-cache layouts and prefix caching, integrating into modern serving engines such as SGLang and vLLM. translated_title: OSCAR：面向2比特KV缓存量化的离线谱协方差感知旋转
translated_abstract: INT2 KV缓存量化对于长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务极具吸引力，但如何使其既准确又实用仍具挑战性。数据无关的旋转方法（如Hadamard变换）可以平滑通道离群值，但由于忽略了下游注意力机制如何查询缓存，其在INT2精度下仍会急剧退化。我们提出OSCAR，一种超低比特KV缓存量化方法，它通过离线估计注意力感知的协方差目标，进而推导出固定的逐层旋转和裁剪阈值。通过将量化基与注意力所依赖的二阶矩结构对齐，OSCAR在2比特精度下保持了注意力的保真度。除了在冻结误差代理下的理论分析之外，我们还构建了可投入服务的OSCAR系统，配备融合的Triton写入与解码内核，保留分页KV缓存布局和前缀缓存功能，并可集成到SGLang和vLLM等现代服务引擎中。我们在……上对OSCAR进行了评估（摘要至此处截断）。
tldr: OSCAR通过离线估计注意力感知的协方差目标来推导固定的逐层旋转与裁剪阈值，实现了精确且可实际部署的2比特KV缓存量化，并能无缝集成到SGLang和vLLM等现代推理服务引擎中。
en_tdlr: OSCAR achieves accurate and practical 2-bit KV cache quantization by offline estimating attention-aware covariance targets to derive fixed per-layer rotations and clipping thresholds, with a serving-ready system integrated into engines like SGLang and vLLM.
